notes: YouTube hit a sign-in bot wall mid-session on the shared IP; fixed per coordinator with --js-runtimes node --extractor-args youtube:player_client=android, one download at a time. Most packages came instead from 1News article pages, which yt-dlp resolves to Brightcove (720p). RNZ, Stuff and Te Ao Māori News pages are not extractable by yt-dlp; the Te Ao package was pulled from its HLS stream (CloudFront) found in the page source. NZ Herald video came via its Brightcove player URL found in the page source. All clips are 16:9 unless stated.
